messages:
alex: quick check — rolled the sampler change (canary) to the prefetch microbatcher and now it looks like most batch-worker spans disappeared from Tempo. any pointers where to start investigating? @oncall-bot can you check if the canary rolled cleanly? :eyes:
jun_chen: first things: did the canary include a collector/OTEL SDK change or just a config toggle? also check collector logs for rejected or dropped spans.
maria: if it's just a sampler tweak, check both the SDK env vars and the collector's receiver/processor config. sometimes the sampler on the SDK is different from collector-level sampling.
alex: it was a small config change in the app SDK (Node). sample-rate -> 0.02 in our rollout. no collector change. here's the snippet I deployed to the canary container:
```js
// instrument.js
const { NodeTracerProvider } = require('@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node');
const { ParentBasedSampler, TraceIdRatioBasedSampler } = require('@opentelemetry/core');
const provider = new NodeTracerProvider({
  sampler: new ParentBasedSampler({ root: new TraceIdRatioBasedSampler(0.02) })
});
provider.register();
```
priya: a few quick checks: 1) confirm OTEL_PROPAGATORS matches other services (tracecontext,baggage). 2) curl a running prefetcher request and verify traceparent header is present (service -> downstream). 3) query logs for trace ids you saw before.
olivia: dashboards: Grafana traces overview: https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/d/trace-overview ; Tempo search: https://tempo.internal.redwood.com/trace/  — try searching the worker service name and a time window around the deploy.
oncall-bot: Canary deployment 2265000930 -> prefetcher-canary v3 applied to 2 pods in staging (stability: OK, rollout: partial). Logs forwarded to collector from those pods.
maria: also check the SDK version — older opentelemetry-node versions had a bug where ParentBasedSampler was not honored for some async spans (we hit this last quarter). what is package.json tracer version?
alex: package.json shows @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node 1.12.0.
jun_chen: try forcing OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=traceidratio in the container env to see if behavior changes. also set OTEL_LOG_LEVEL=debug to get sampler decisions in SDK logs. command:
```bash
kubectl exec -it svc-prefetcher-canary -- /bin/sh -c 'export OTEL_LOG_LEVEL=debug; ./start.sh'
```
priya: Loki query to see dropped-span logs: {job="prefetcher"} |= "sampler" or |= "dropped" then json parse and look for reason.
alex: doing the debug run now. will post results in ~15m. thanks for the links. :thumbsup:
-- ~30 minutes later --
alex: update: debug logs show the SDK is emitting "Sampled: 0" for most traces, but incoming requests include traceparent headers with sampled=1. looks like parent-based code path is taking root sampler decisions instead of honoring incoming parent. suspect Node SDK bug + our usage of async local context in worker.
maria: makes sense. quick repro: spawn a single request locally with same headers and see if the provider picks Sampled=1. if repro holds, try switching to a plain TraceIdRatioBasedSampler(0.02) (no ParentBased wrapper) to see if that matches previous behavior.
jun_chen: also check if any middleware or custom propagator is mutating traceparent. grep in repo for setHeader('traceparent') or any manual header manipulation.
olivia: if you need a temporary mitigation, we can route prefetcher traffic to dedicated sampler=always_on for the canary pods while we root-cause. but that raises cost — probably fine for short window.
alex: quick grep: found a small helper that rewrites headers for legacy clients. removing that fixes the propagated parent. rolling a hotfix to canary now and will watch Tempo.
oncall-bot: Patch rollout started: prefetcher-canary v3.1 -> 2 pods. Canary health OK.
alex: confirmed: spans reappeared in Tempo after the hotfix. looks like header rewrite was the culprit. thanks everyone. logging follow-up: I'll open a PR to add an integration test for trace propagation and ping infra to add a dashboard alert for sudden drop in service traces (percent of requests with attached trace over 5m).
maria: +1 on the test and alert. suggest alert: if traces_count(service=prefetcher) drops >80% vs median in last 30m then page eng-oncall.
priya: I'll file the alert PR if you add the query. happy to pair on test.
alex: will create PRs and @pri ya for alert. wrapping up — thanks all. :raised_hands:
